### Differential Prevalence- Make tables and export for manuscript (Supplement table S7)
```{r}
make_prevalence_publication_table <- function(prevalence_obj) {
  x <- as.data.frame(prevalence_obj$results)

  if (nrow(x) == 0L) {
    x <- data.frame(
      taxonomic_level = character(),
      taxon_name = character(),
      TaxonID = character(),
      name = character(),
      coef = numeric(),
      stderr = numeric(),
      pval = numeric(),
      qval = numeric(),
      model_status = character(),
      error = character(),
      n_samples = integer(),
      n_detected = integer(),
      n_zero = integer()
    )
  }

  x %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      taxonomic_level,
      taxon_name,
      comparison = dplyr::case_when(
        name == "treatmentmaurum" ~ "Treatment (HC)",
        name == "conditionIS" ~ "Condition (BBS)",
        name %in% c(
          "treatmentmaurum:conditionIS",
          "conditionIS:treatmentmaurum"
        ) ~ "Treatment x condition",
        name == "log_read_depth" ~ "Sequencing depth",
        TRUE ~ as.character(name)
      ),
      model_term = as.character(name),
      log_odds_coefficient = coef,
      standard_error = stderr,
      p_value = pval,
      fdr_q_value = qval,
      significant_fdr_0.05 = dplyr::case_when(
        !(model_status %in% "Fitted") |
          !is.finite(pval) | !is.finite(qval) ~ "Review",
        qval < 0.05 ~ "Yes",
        TRUE ~ "No"
      ),
      model_status,
      model_diagnostic = as.character(error),
      n_samples,
      n_detected,
      n_zero,
      TaxonID
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(comparison, fdr_q_value, taxon_name)
}

phylum_prevalence_table <- make_prevalence_publication_table(
  phylum_prevalence_filtered
)

genus_prevalence_table <- make_prevalence_publication_table(
  genus_prevalence_filtered
)

stopifnot(
  nrow(phylum_prevalence_table) == 8L,
  nrow(genus_prevalence_table) == 248L
)

prevalence_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  phylum_prevalence_table,
  genus_prevalence_table
) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(taxonomic_level, comparison) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_taxa = dplyr::n_distinct(TaxonID),
    n_tests = dplyr::n(),
    n_evaluable = sum(significant_fdr_0.05 %in% c("Yes", "No")),
    n_significant = sum(significant_fdr_0.05 == "Yes"),
    n_for_review = sum(significant_fdr_0.05 == "Review"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

prevalence_taxon_status <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  phylum_prevalence_filtered$taxon_status,
  genus_prevalence_filtered$taxon_status
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    prevalence_percent = 100 * n_detected / n_samples,
    test_status = dplyr::if_else(
      n_detected > 0 & n_detected < n_samples,
      "Submitted to prevalence model",
      "Not tested: no detection variation"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(taxonomic_level, taxon_name, TaxonID)

prevalence_methods <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Setting, ~Description,
  "Model",
  "Logistic mixed model: detection ~ treatment * condition + log_read_depth + (1 | cohort). Data augmentation was enabled.",
  "Treatment (HC)",
  "M. aurum versus BBS.",
  "Condition (BBS)",
  "IS versus HC.",
  "Treatment x condition",
  "Change in the M. aurum-versus-BBS log-odds contrast under IS compared with HC.",
  "Sequencing depth",
  "Standardized log10 library size, calculated using all reads in the original count table before selecting taxa.",
  "Detection definition",
  "At least one read indicates detection. The 0.01% pooled filter selected taxa for analysis; it was not used as a within-sample detection threshold.",
  "Taxon and sample scope",
  "All 72 animals and the 6 phyla and 85 genera returned by the filtered ANCOM-BC2 fits were considered. Of these, 2 phyla and 62 genera had variable detection and were modeled.",
  "Constant detection",
  "Taxa with no detection variation were not tested and are listed in Taxon_Status.",
  "P-values and FDR",
  "Individual p-values and BH q-values were retained from each rank-specific MaAsLin 3 fit. The adjustment included sequencing-depth associations. The reporting threshold was q < 0.05.",
  "Interpretation",
  "The models assess observed detection. Screening for prevalence associations potentially induced by abundance differences was disabled (warn_prevalence = FALSE).",
  "Diagnostics",
  "Model diagnostics were retained from MaAsLin 3. Rows with a diagnostic or nonfinite p- or q-value are marked Review.",
  "Phylum MaAsLin 3 version",
  as.character(phylum_prevalence_filtered$software_version),
  "Genus MaAsLin 3 version",
  as.character(genus_prevalence_filtered$software_version),
  "Reference",
  "Nickols WA, Kuntz T, Shen J, et al. (2026). MaAsLin 3. Nature Methods 23:554–564. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-025-02923-9"
)

prevalence_export_tables <- list(
  Summary = prevalence_summary,
  Phylum_Prevalence = phylum_prevalence_table,
  Genus_Prevalence = genus_prevalence_table,
  Taxon_Status = prevalence_taxon_status,
  Methods = prevalence_methods
)

print(prevalence_summary, n = Inf)


# Worksheets to export
prevalence_export_tables <- list(

# Create a separate workbook

)

for (sheet_name in names(prevalence_export_tables)) {

  sheet_data <- as.data.frame(

  )

  openxlsx::addWorksheet(

      nrow(sheet_data) > 0L &&
        sheet_name != "Methods"
    ),

  )

  openxlsx::freezePane(

  )

  openxlsx::setColWidths(
    prevalence_wb,

    widths = pmin(
      38,
      pmax(16, nchar(names(sheet_data)) + 2)
    )
  )

  openxlsx::setRowHeights(
    prevalence_wb,
    sheet = sheet_name,
    rows = 1,
    heights = 36
  )

# Display formatting preserves underlying numerical precision
  if (nrow(sheet_data) > 0L) {

    data_rows <- seq_len(nrow(sheet_data)) + 1L

    format_groups <- list(
      decimal = which(
        names(sheet_data) %in%
          c("log_odds_coefficient", "standard_error")
      ),
      probability = which(
        names(sheet_data) %in%
          c("p_value", "fdr_q_value")
      ),
      count = grep("^n_", names(sheet_data)),
      percent = which(
        names(sheet_data) == "prevalence_percent"
      )
    )

    format_styles <- list(
      decimal = prevalence_decimal_style,
      probability = prevalence_probability_style,
      count = prevalence_count_style,
      percent = prevalence_percent_style
    )

    for (format_name in names(format_groups)) {

      columns <- format_groups[[format_name]]

      if (length(columns) > 0L) {
        openxlsx::addStyle(
          prevalence_wb,
          sheet = sheet_name,
          style = format_styles[[format_name]],
          rows = data_rows,
          cols = columns,
          gridExpand = TRUE,
          stack = TRUE
        )
      }
    }

# Wrap taxon names and diagnostic messages
    text_columns <- which(
      names(sheet_data) %in%
        c("taxon_name", "model_diagnostic", "test_status")
    )

    if (length(text_columns) > 0L) {
      openxlsx::addStyle(
        prevalence_wb,
        sheet = sheet_name,
        style = openxlsx::createStyle(
          wrapText = TRUE,
          valign = "top"
        ),
        rows = data_rows,
        cols = text_columns,
        gridExpand = TRUE,
        stack = TRUE
      )

      openxlsx::setRowHeights(
        prevalence_wb,
        sheet = sheet_name,
        rows = data_rows,
        heights = 45
      )
    }
  }
}

# Format the methods and references

)
```

###############################################################################

## Statistical Analysis: Post-hoc Fisher's LSD 
```{r}
# Which which factors are driving the treatment x stress interaction
select_significant_interactions <- function(interaction_table) {
  interaction_table %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(fdr_q_value),
      fdr_q_value < 0.05,
      # Incorporate ANCOM-BC2 sensitivity analysis
      !is.na(passed_sensitivity),
      passed_sensitivity == TRUE
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(
      TaxonID,
      taxon_name,
      .keep_all = TRUE
    ) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      TaxonID,
      taxon_name,
      parent_interaction_lfc =
        log_fold_change,
      parent_interaction_p =
        p_value,
      parent_interaction_q =
        fdr_q_value,
      parent_passed_sensitivity =
        passed_sensitivity)
}

significant_phylum_interactions <-
  select_significant_interactions(
    phylum_interaction_table)

significant_genus_interactions <-
  select_significant_interactions(
    genus_interaction_table)


# Post-hoc screening for treatment x stress interaction 
# Fisher's LSD post-hoc testing will only be performed when:
#   1. ANCOM-BC2 interaction FDR q < 0.05
#   2. ANCOM-BC2 pseudo-count sensitivity analysis is passed
# If either criterion is not met, no interaction-specific
# Fisher's LSD follow-up is performed.

add_posthoc_screening <- function(interaction_table) {
  interaction_table %>%
    dplyr::mutate(

# Post-hoc eligibility
      posthoc_eligible = dplyr::case_when(

        !is.na(fdr_q_value) &
          fdr_q_value < 0.05 &
          !is.na(passed_sensitivity) &
          passed_sensitivity == TRUE ~
          "Yes",
        TRUE ~
          "No"),

# Explain why a taxon did or did not proceed
  posthoc_status = dplyr::case_when(
        is.na(fdr_q_value) ~
          "No post-hoc: FDR q-value unavailable",
        fdr_q_value >= 0.05 ~
          "No post-hoc: interaction not FDR-significant",
        fdr_q_value < 0.05 &
          (is.na(passed_sensitivity) | passed_sensitivity != TRUE) ~
          "No post-hoc: sensitivity criterion not passed",
        fdr_q_value < 0.05 &
          passed_sensitivity == TRUE ~
          "Fisher LSD post-hoc indicated",
        TRUE ~ "No post-hoc"))
}

# Apply post-hoc screening 
phylum_interaction_table <- add_posthoc_screening(
  phylum_interaction_table)

genus_interaction_table <- add_posthoc_screening(
  genus_interaction_table)

# Identify taxa eligible for Fisher's LSD 
significant_phylum_interactions <-
  phylum_interaction_table %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    posthoc_eligible == "Yes")

significant_genus_interactions <-
  genus_interaction_table %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    posthoc_eligible == "Yes")

# Post-hoc screening summary 
make_posthoc_summary <- function(
  interaction_table,
  rank_name
) {

  tibble::tibble(
    taxonomic_level =
    rank_name,
    effect =
      "Treatment x Stress interaction",
    screening_criterion =
      "ANCOM-BC2 FDR q < 0.05 and sensitivity passed",
    total_taxa_tested =
      nrow(interaction_table),
    nominal_p_less_0.05 =
      sum(
        !is.na(interaction_table$p_value) &
          interaction_table$p_value < 0.05),
    fdr_q_less_0.05 =
      sum(
        !is.na(interaction_table$fdr_q_value) &
          interaction_table$fdr_q_value < 0.05),
    sensitivity_passed =
      sum(
        !is.na(interaction_table$passed_sensitivity) &
          interaction_table$passed_sensitivity == TRUE),
    eligible_for_posthoc =
      sum(
        interaction_table$posthoc_eligible == "Yes",
        na.rm = TRUE),
    fisher_lsd_posthoc_performed =
      dplyr::if_else(
        sum(
          interaction_table$posthoc_eligible == "Yes",
          na.rm = TRUE
        ) > 0,
        "Yes",
        "No"))
}

phylum_posthoc_summary <- make_posthoc_summary(
  phylum_interaction_table,"Phylum")

genus_posthoc_summary <- make_posthoc_summary(
  genus_interaction_table,"Genus")

posthoc_screening_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  phylum_posthoc_summary, genus_posthoc_summary)

# Update ANCOMB-BC2 table with post-hoc summary results 
ancombc2_publication_table <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  phylum_treatment_table,
  phylum_condition_table,
  phylum_interaction_table,
  genus_treatment_table,
  genus_condition_table,
  genus_interaction_table)

# Export updated ANCOM-BC table to Excel
dir.create(

)
```
